structured.approach: Ran the frontend-steps skill procedure for FE-01. I read both inputs: feat.tasks, to find the Frontend task and its repository (TSK-07, ap_portal), and org.engineering_stack, for the stack, CI and branch rules. The hook blocked shell commands for this step. So I took availability, branch and write access from the step's tool view (tool:repo-access) and confirmed the details by reading repository files: package.json, src/ap_portal/index.js, ci.mjs, CLAUDE.md and .git/HEAD. The repository already exists, so it did not need to be created. I wrote task.repo_access with the result, the repository profile TSK-07 needs, and one non-blocking question about the branch name. No connectors were needed.
tools_used: Bash (blocked by G9 hook; no shell commands ran)

claims.text: The Frontend lane's task is TSK-07 (STORY-07), which renders the overdue risk table with renderOverdueRisk in the ap_portal repository.
Repository ap_portal is available locally and the agent identity has write access; the working tree is clean.
Branch feature/story was created from dev at ff761ee and is the checked-out branch.
No Databricks, other workspace or database is used by ap_portal.
ap_portal uses Node.js 22 with node:test, and its CI command is node ci.mjs.
The CI enforces a syntax check, line coverage of at least 90%, no console.log or eval( lines, and lines of at most 140 characters.
The current version is 2.3.0 in both src/ap_portal/index.js and package.json.
The existing exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary must be kept.
Commit messages start with the story ID.
feat.tasks names the branch pattern feature/<story>, and the branch model is main (released), dev (integration) and feature branches.

open_questions: RAQ-1 (non-blocking): feat.tasks gives the branch pattern feature/<story> (feature/STORY-07), but the spine created feature/story. Is feature/story the intended branch for TSK-07? Interim answer: use feature/story and keep the STORY-07 commit prefix.
structured.summary: ap_portal is available with write access on branch feature/story, created from dev at ff761ee. No repository creation is needed, and no Databricks or database is involved. task.repo_access records the result, the repository profile TSK-07 needs (Node.js 22, node:test, node ci.mjs, coverage of at least 90%, version 2.3.0, files in budget present) and one non-blocking question about the branch name.

tool_input.command: git status && git branch -a && git log --oneline -3 && git remote -v; ls; ls src/ap_portal tests; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; touch .write_probe && rm .write_probe && echo WRITE_OK
tool_input.description: Check repo status, branches, layout and write access
